title: The Second Coming of Christ: Making of a Scripture | Sri Daya Mata and Sri Mrinalini Mata

# The Second Coming of Christ: Making of a Scripture

### Reflecting on the Divine Legacy of Paramahansa Yogananda
*Featuring the sacred reminiscences of Sri Daya Mata and Sri Mrinalini Mata, former Presidents of Self-Realization Fellowship / Yogoda Satsanga Society of India*

---

### The Descent of Divine Revelation

In the annals of spiritual history, there are rare moments when the veil between the visible world and the infinite realms of Spirit is drawn aside. The creation of Paramahansa Yogananda’s monumental commentary, *The Second Coming of Christ: The Resurrection of the Christ Within You*, represents one of those sublime epochs. This sacred scripture was not born of mere intellectual scholarship or theological analysis; rather, it was received through direct, face-to-face communion with the Divine. 

Our beloved Guru, Paramahansa Yogananda, was chosen by Jesus Christ and the lineage of Mahavatar Babaji to bring back the original, pure, and undistorted teachings of the Christian Bible. His mission was to demonstrate the essential, underlying unity between the original yoga of Bhagavan Krishna and the original Christianity of Lord Jesus. To witness the making of this scripture was to witness the descent of Truth itself. Sri Daya Mata and Sri Mrinalini Mata, who stood as close disciples and witnesses to this divine process, have shared deep, soul-stirring memories of those days of heavenly visitation, illustrating how the Master lived in a state of constant, uninterrupted communion with the Divine Mother and Jesus Christ.

### Communion in the Hermitage at Encinitas

Much of this great work was dictated in the quiet, spiritually charged atmosphere of the Self-Realization Fellowship Hermitage in Encinitas, California. Sri Daya Mata recalled how the Guru would sit for hours, his eyes locked in the upward gaze of deep ecstasy, totally oblivious to the passage of time. The room would become filled with an almost tangible, overwhelming vibration of divine love and peace. 

Sri Daya Mata once wrote of these sacred hours:

> "As I took his dictation, I knew that I was in the presence of one who was talking directly with God, who was listening to the voice of Jesus himself. Often, the Guru’s face would flush with the warmth of divine ecstasy, and tears of love would flow down his cheeks. He was not thinking; he was perceiving. He was seeing the scenes of the New Testament play out before his inner eye, and he was describing what he saw and felt in that state of complete oneness with the Christ Consciousness."

This was not a process of writing a book; it was a process of recording revelation. The Master often remarked that Jesus Christ himself was present in the room, guiding the interpretation of his own words. When the Master had doubts about the exact meaning of certain obscure passages in the Gospels, he would pray deeply, and Jesus would appear to him, confirming the exact spiritual meaning of his words. This scripture is, therefore, a direct bridge between the human soul and the living Christ.

### The Sacred Role of Sri Mrinalini Mata

To Sri Mrinalini Mata, the Guru entrusted the monumental task of compiling, organizing, and editing his vast commentaries. She recalled the immense spiritual training she received under his direct supervision. He trained her mind to tune in to his own consciousness, so that even after he left his physical form, she would be able to discern exactly how he wished the scripture to be presented to the world.

Sri Mrinalini Mata described the Master’s dedication to this project as a labor of absolute love for God. She noted that he worked day and night, disregarding his own physical comfort and health, driven by an urgent desire to place this spiritual treasure in the hands of seeking souls. 

> "The Master would tell us, 'The world is sleepwalking in a dream of delusion. They do not know the great treasure they possess within themselves. This book will be a beacon of light to lead them out of the darkness of ignorance into the glorious, resplendent light of the Christ Consciousness.' He poured his very life-blood into these pages, knowing that they would serve as a spiritual roadmap for centuries to come."

### What is the "Second Coming"?

One of the most profound revelations of this scripture is the true meaning of the "Second Coming of Christ." Paramahansaji clarified that this does not refer to a physical descent of Jesus on a cloud in the sky—a literal event that would only benefit a small number of people in one geographic location. Instead, the true Second Coming is the resurrection of the *Christ Consciousness*—the Kutastha Chaitanya—within the temple of the devotee's own pure, meditative consciousness.

Jesus reached that state of oneness with the Infinite where his individual consciousness became identical to the intelligence of God active throughout the universe. To receive Christ, we must expand our own consciousness until it can hold that ocean of infinite love and light. The Master taught that every soul has the potential to awaken this dormant divinity within, transcending all barriers of dogma, creed, and race.

### Step-by-Step Spiritual Habits to Awaken the Christ Within

To help us realize this state of inner resurrection, Paramahansa Yogananda, Sri Daya Mata, and Sri Mrinalini Mata emphasized several essential spiritual practices that we can cultivate daily:

*   **Deep, Devotional Meditation:** Commit to daily meditation using the scientific techniques of Kriya Yoga. It is in the silence of deep meditation that the inner chatter of the mind is stilled, allowing the Christ peace to enter.
*   **Cultivating Constant Devotion:** Pray to the Divine Mother and the Great Gurus with a yearning heart. Talk to Them as your closest friends, whispering your love and longing in the quiet corners of your mind.
*   **The Practice of the Presence of God:** Throughout the busy day, keep a part of your attention anchored in the divine center. Silently repeat a mantra, a prayer, or the name of God, recognizing His presence in everyone you meet.
*   **Developing Dynamic Will Power:** Use your God-given will to overcome habits of laziness, restlessness, and negativity. Channel your energy into constructive, spiritually uplifting activities.
*   **Serving God in Others:** See the living Christ residing in all beings. Reach out in selfless service, kindness, and compassion to those in need, for as Jesus said, "Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me."
*   **Studying Scripture with Intuition:** Read the words of the Masters not just with the intellect, but with an open heart. Ponder deeply on a single verse, allowing its spiritual vibration to penetrate your consciousness.

### The Living Presence in the Written Word

Sri Daya Mata often reminded devotees that the spirit of the Guru is fully alive and present in his writings. When we read *The Second Coming of Christ* with devotion and an open heart, we are not merely absorbing information; we are entering into a sacred sanctuary where we can feel the touch of the Master’s hand and the warmth of his unconditional love. 

The making of this scripture was a divine gift to humanity, a monument of Truth designed to guide us home to the Infinite. As we study its pages and practice its universal principles, we accelerate our own spiritual evolution, preparing our hearts to become fitting altars for the birth of the Christ Child.

### A Closing Prayer and Blessing

*O Divine Mother, Lord Jesus Christ, Mahavatar Babaji, Paramahansa Yogananda, and the great lineage of Gurus, we bow to Thee in deepest gratitude. Thank You for bringing the light of this sacred scripture to guide our steps in the darkness of this world. 

Resurrect Thy love within our hearts. Let Thy light shine through our eyes, Thy voice speak through our lips, and Thy peace flow through our actions. Clear away the mists of delusion and selfishness, and awaken the dormant Christ Consciousness within us. May we feel Thy living presence guiding us in every moment of our lives, until we are eternally merged in Thine infinite ocean of Bliss and Love.*

*Jai Guru. Jai Ma.*
